host.client: the maintainers' iOS client, TestFlight build 2

time.identifierClock: the report's updatedAt in the owner's local time, UTC-4, which the archive file names use

coverage.traceScope: the client's trace of its connection at export

interpretation.sourceIndex: zero-based original transactions array index; order preserved
interpretation.sequence: the client's own count within its trace; not a PTP transaction ID
interpretation.rawPayloadEncoding: hexadecimal bytes in source order, little-endian scalar interpretation
interpretation.dataPhase: the bytes the client handed to ImageCaptureCore or received from it; the USB wire is not observed
interpretation.responseOrigin: the response code ImageCaptureCore returned to the client; not an independent bus capture
interpretation.durationMs: host-measured time from handing over the command to its completion
interpretation.clientRecords: the client's own derived records, allowlisted; its interpretation, not camera responses
interpretation.ownerReportedCamera: what the owner entered as the camera's menu reading; not a photograph
interpretation.findingNumbers: unsigned integers unless explicitly labeled; not byte strings

omissions: serial hash, host device model, guided-test session identifiers and USB identifiers
bank and recipe names wherever they occur, and all D18D payloads except the two empty-name encodings (00 and 010000)
DeviceInfo, descriptor, conversion-profile and object payloads in the ledger
parameters of operations other than property get, set and describe
the client's property labels, free-text notes and messages except reviewed forms parsed into typed fields
the backup's share-sheet activity, problem reports, app logs, photographs and JPEGs
transform.disclosureCheck: every output searched for each private string of the original, plain, JSON-escaped and UTF-16 hex
transform.generatedFacts: No missing times, conditions, or hardware observations are invented; finding interpretations are labeled.
